eventsDoc: bf-click (composed, bubbles) — detail.payload when using payload attr

link.cssHint: Theme tokens plus ::part(...) if defined on bf-link shadow root.

input.cssHint: Prefer theme tokens (--bf-theme-* surfaces on form controls). Inspect bf-input CSS for component-scoped vars.

header.cssHint: Chrome components use slot content; tune via theme layout tokens.

footer.cssHint: Uses bf-footer shadow + slots; inherit theme typography and surfaces.

modal.cssHint: Overlay/panel styling often uses bf-modal::part(...) — see Parts list from build.

dialog.cssHint: Multiple variants share host; compose ::part(panel) etc. where exposed.

toast.cssHint: Position + variant via attributes; toast ::part(close) pattern when exposed.

message.cssHint: Inline/alerts inherit theme foreground and surfaces.

error-summary.cssHint: Form rollup pattern; inherits theme semantic colors via tokens.

checkbox.cssHint: Checkbox label + native control synced in shadow.

select.cssHint: Native-like select facade; prefers theme spacing and borders.

toggle.cssHint: Switch vs toggle variants use role switch + aria-checked.

chart.cssHint: Labs placeholder; relies on bf-chart tokens once finalized.
